ridge_selection: last 126 past labels, fitted on preceding labels; mean per-series Gaussian QLIKE, then refit full history
features: Own, market and sector log-variance disjoint HAR lags; include leave-one-out market and sector features
correlation_target: rank-three factor projection of past-126 reference-session EWMA realized correlations, half-life 20; monthly eigenvectors from preceding 252 retained observed correlation matrices; residual diagonal floor 0.05; normalize diagonal
primary_correlation: Equal convex blend of factor correlation target and causal Log/Fisher GHAR correlation forecast
controls: Ridge log-HAR + original Log/Fisher graph correlation
multivariate_control: All stock log-variance HAR features, same causal ridge CV and smearing
evaluation: Exactly same 642 dates as previous experiment; 245 development and 397 reused later dates
iteration_rule: Freeze this study before evaluating outputs; retain all challengers and failures; no test-outcome-driven retuning
uncertainty: paired stationary bootstrap 10000 draws mean block10 seed20261127; exploratory reused-data inference
